evidence.quote_en: Accordingly, to concretize and strengthen government initiatives based on the AI Technology Strategy, this provisional execution plan sets out targets and timelines for each measure, ahead of formulating a full-scale plan to compete globally amid fierce international competition.

implementation_notes: Provisional government execution plan (August 2018) operationalizing Japan's March 2017 Artificial Intelligence Technology Strategy and Industrialization Roadmap across five pillars: (1) R&D (priority sectors of productivity, health/medical/nursing care, mobility, information security, smart agriculture, i-Construction, AI Hospital, disaster SIP4D, next-gen trustworthy/explainable AI, and 100x-efficiency AI chips), (2) talent development (top-level researchers, recurrent adult education, vocational IT training for job seekers, university data-science curricula, and universal K-12 IT literacy by 2032), (3) cross-sector and sectoral data-linkage platforms (full operation targeted by FY2022), (4) venture/startup support (NEDO open innovation, startup task force parity with the US and China), and (5) public understanding (commissioning the Social Principles of Human-Centric AI in FY2018). Pure R&D and industrial execution roadmap containing zero regulatory enforcement or sanction hooks; subsequently superseded by AI Strategy 2022.
